**Synopsis:**
Global bond yields surged to multi-year highs while equities sold off, driven by Middle East conflict, oil above $100/bbl, fiscal concerns, and AI capex spending. The article centers on Friday's upcoming U.S. CPI print as a pivotal data point for Fed policy. PPI came in warm, pushing markets to price a 70/30 chance of a Fed rate hike next week. Inflation expectations are rising sharply. The ECB hiked and signaled more to come. UK and French bond yields hit decades-long highs. Bond auctions remained solid, but primary/secondary market dynamics diverge.
